investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: An NSG modification was detected for nsg-aks-dev-01 in a non-production resource group, where an 'Allow' rule named AllowDevWebService permits inbound TCP 8080 from any source to 13.75.144.22. The change was initiated at 17:33 EET by a Service Principal with Contributor scope and occurred during Estonian working hours. There are no recent deployment events or similar alerts correlating to this change, and the rule opens a non-management port in a dev/test environment, so I assess this as Low Priority based on environment, timing, and lack of broader indicators of compromise.
investigation_notes.Rule Summary: AllowDevWebService: Allow inbound TCP 8080 from any source to 13.75.144.22; AllowVnetInBound: Allow inbound VNet traffic (priority 65000).
